notes: Design decisions that deviated from or elaborated on the dispatch prompt, with reasoning: (1) IFaceSearchFeatureFlagPolicy adapter lives in the bio-ten-003 feature project itself (Integration/TenantFeatureFlagPolicyAdapter.cs), requiring a feature-to-feature ProjectReference to BIO-BIO-007's own csproj, rather than as a nested class inside BioBio007Module.cs - this keeps that file's edit to the smallest possible diff (one line + one using + one sentence) as the dispatch prompt explicitly required, and mirrors BIO-BIO-007's own precedent of a feature-to-feature reference to consume another feature's public contract (it references BIO-BIO-001 for the identical reason). (2) The end-to-end AC02/AC04 proof for FaceSearchService does not construct that internal type directly or call SearchAsync on it - it is internal to BIO-BIO-007's own assembly with InternalsVisibleTo granted only to Biolog.Api and its own test project, and widening that grant would mean editing a file owned by BIO-BIO-007's engineer, which was not pre-approved. Tests instead exercise the real resolved IFaceSearchFeatureFlagPolicy instance directly - disclosed in full in the README's AC04 section. (3) No bash .test.sh structural harness was added - judged unnecessary since every behavioural claim is already covered by the C# test suite; the one genuinely one-time structural fact (the BioBio007Module.cs registration swap) is recorded in this evidence file's diff instead of a repeatable check. (4) Evidence and docs paths used evidence/features/bio-ten-003/** and the existing docs/features/bio-ten-003/README.md path (matching governance/feature-path-ownership.json's actual owned_paths and this codebase's real precedent, e.g. evidence/features/bio-ten-001/builder/), rather than the evidence/BIO-TEN-003/builder/ path named in the dispatch prompt, which does not match any existing story's actual builder-evidence location in this repository.
